content.comment_body: In [product_name] [version_no], there is a bug affecting the bar graph feature. It is not possible to set the maximum value in the bar graph settings.
Issue confirmed. Try adjusting the window size. However, I did not change the window dimensions. Why does the window with default settings fail to show all options? This seems to be a bug as well.

analysis.insight_summary: Users have found that in [product_name] [version_no], the bar graph configuration lacks an option to set the maximum value, reducing its flexibility. There are also concerns that the default window size does not reveal all relevant configuration fields, causing confusion and possible misinterpretation of the interface’s completeness. These problems lead to user frustration about both the app’s features and its interface design.
analysis.user_expectations: Users expect all key configuration options, such as setting a maximum value, to be easily available by default, and for the window to display all options without needing manual resizing.
